property_summary: After initialize() sets owner to the deployer and a call to transferOwnership(newOwner) with newOwner != address(0), the general rule 'owner() == newOwner for every admissible newOwner' always holds on the reference C, but the mutant transfers ownership to address(0), so owner() == address(0) instead of newOwner for any nonzero newOwner.
change_summary: Transfer ownership to address(0) instead of newOwner, changing the value returned by owner() after any call.
